sentences.text: This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
ORDER The applicant has filed this first bail application u/S.439 Cr.P.C for grant of bail.
Applicant has been arrested on 25.4.2023 by Police Station City Kotwali, Morena in connection with Crime No.396/2023 registered for offence under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 473 of IPC.

Learned counsel for the State referred the fact that not only unfilled forms regarding Aadhar Card and other government schemes were found in the possession of the applicant but also one seal /
stamp of Principal, Government Higher Secondary School No. 2, Morena was found, therefore, it appears that for monetary lust, applicant was involved in preparation of forged Aadhar Cards which is an act against the national as well as social interest.
Considering the nature of allegations and the fact that charge-sheet is yet to be filed, no case for bail is made out.
